verification_results.claim_text: The Transformer allows significantly more parallelization than recurrent sequence models.
verification_results.explanation: The cited paper discusses alternative sequence architectures and efficiency improvements, but does not directly establish the specific claim about Transformer parallelization.
verification_results.evidence_span: A convolutional architecture enables fully parallel computation over all elements in a sequence.

verification_results.claim_text: Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of sequence modeling and transduction models.
verification_results.citation_title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
verification_results.explanation: The cited paper directly introduces and validates attention in sequence-to-sequence neural machine translation.
verification_results.evidence_span: The model learns to align and translate jointly using an attention mechanism.

trust_report.summary: Most key claims are supported or partially supported by their cited references.
